theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_dlb_ae_hasDensity_of_restricted
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U Ω : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (W : Varifold N n Ω) (c : ℝ≥0∞), c ≠ 0 → c ≠ ∞ → W.measure = c • V.measure.restrict (Ω ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → (∀ᵐ y ∂W.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n W.weight y θ ∧ 1 ≤ θ) → ∀ᵐ y ∂V.weight, y ∈ Ω → ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight y θ ∧ c⁻¹ ≤ θ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
